fusions.name: Scatter of Brads
fusions.desc: Drives 3 barbed nails out in a spread, each dealing 5 damage with a 50% chance to leave its target [Poisoned] for 5 seconds. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Stinger Driven Home
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 12 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Tinkers' Swarm
fusions.desc: After a 1-second cast, calls a swarm for 15 seconds that taps at an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second, each tap with a 30% chance to leave it [Sundered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Cobbler's Tempo
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
